data.one_liner: Provides network-aware widgets and connectivity feedback for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package that offers network-aware widgets to give users feedback when they are offline or when connectivity is lost. It integrates with provider and connectivity_plus to monitor network changes and update UI elements accordingly.
use_when: You want to display a banner or overlay when the user loses internet connection.
You need to disable specific UI components (like sign-in buttons) when offline.
You want a simple declarative way to handle network-aware widgets app-wide or per-screen.
avoid_when: You need complex network state management beyond simple online/offline UI feedback.
You are relying solely on connectivity state for making critical network calls without timeout handling.
strengths: Easy setup for global or per-screen offline feedback via wrapper widgets.
Supports custom offline widgets, messages, and decorations.
Built-in handling of subscription disposal and resource cleanup.
weaknesses: Depends on the underlying platform connectivity checks which may occasionally give false positives.
Requires specific platform configurations (such as Android Gradle Plugin, Java 17, and iOS 13+ for v2.0.0).
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart 3.6+ and updates to platform settings such as Java 17, Android Gradle Plugin 8.12.1+, Gradle 8.13+, iOS 13+, and macOS 10.15+ for connectivity_plus 7.x compatibility.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need raw network status streams and checks without the pre-built wrapper widgets and UI feedback components.
